title: DroughtObservation
description: A time-bounded physical drought observation or classification record. Preserves source identity, observed/valid time, geometry reference, severity vocabulary, and evidence binding. Must never carry a legal or administrative stage. Must never be derived from a DroughtDeclaration. This object cannot be substituted for DroughtDeclaration.

x-kfm.anti_collapse_rule: DroughtObservation and DroughtDeclaration are separate object families. USDM D0-D4 polygons must never be mapped to Kansas watch/warning/emergency stages.

_fixture_meta.description: Optional fixture-only metadata. Not present in production records.

object_type.description: Discriminator field. Must be exactly 'DroughtObservation' to prevent substitution with DroughtDeclaration.

observation_id.description: Stable identifier for this observation record.

profile_version.description: Version of the source descriptor profile used when this observation was captured.

source_ref.description: Reference to the governed source descriptor. Required; must be bound to a known source identity.

source_resolution_status.description: Resolution state of source_ref. Must be 'bound' before any downstream use.

observed_at.description: The observed or valid time of the physical phenomenon — the instant or start of the interval the observation describes.

observed_interval_end.description: End of the observed interval, or null for point-in-time observations.

retrieved_at.description: Time at which the observation record was retrieved or ingested. Distinct from observed_at and publication_time.

publication_time.description: Time the source published or released this observation. Distinct from observed_at and retrieved_at.

geometry_ref.description: Reference to the governed geometry authority record, or null while unresolved.

geometry_resolution_status.description: Resolution state of geometry_ref. Geometry overlap is evidence of relationship only — not identity or authority equivalence.

geometry_version.description: Version of the geometry at time of observation, or null if unresolved.

classification_vocabulary.description: Source-native classification vocabulary. Must never be silently recoded.

source_native_severity.description: Source-native severity code. Preserved exactly as emitted by source. Must never be mapped to Kansas legal stages (watch/warning/emergency).

method_ref.description: Reference to the method or product identity used to produce this observation.

superseded_by.description: Reference to the observation_id that supersedes this record, if any. Null means not superseded.

correction_of.description: Reference to the observation_id this record corrects, if any.

rights_status.description: Rights posture for this observation record.

release_posture.description: Release state of this observation. Does not grant publication authority.

legal_stage.description: DroughtObservation must never carry a legal stage. This field must not be present.

declaration_derived.description: DroughtObservation must not be derived from a DroughtDeclaration. This field must not be present.
